data.name: Harod
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Harod means 'mountain of God'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word har (mountain) and el (God). It is mentioned in the Old Testament, specifically in the books of Joshua and Samuel. Harod was the site of a major battle between the Israelites and the Philistines. This name is a reminder of God's presence in our lives and His protection during times of conflict.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's presence and protection.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Harod have a strong sense of responsibility and a deep desire to help others. They are reliable, disciplined, and responsible. They have a strong sense of justice and a strong desire to make the world a better place. They are natural leaders and are often very creative and artistic.
